recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray background (#f2f2f2).
2. Add a thin dark red rectangular border (#b71c1c) around the slide content area.
3. Add a text box at top center with 'Neural Network' in large bold red font (#d32f2f), approximately 40-44 pt.
4. Add a text box directly below with 'Back Propagation Training Algorithm' in large bold red font (#d32f2f), approximately 32-36 pt.
5. Add a centered text box in the middle with 'CSAI 253 - Spring 2024' in blue font (#1565c0), approximately 20-24 pt.
6. Add a centered text block below that: 'Prepared By' in red italic (#d32f2f), then on next line 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' in blue (#1565c0), then on next line 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' in blue (#1565c0).
7. Add a text block at bottom left: 'Instructors:' in red bold (#d32f2f), then four lines in blue (#1565c0): 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed', 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg', 'Dr. Mohamed Maher Ata', 'momaher@zewailcity.edu.eg'.
8. Insert the Zewail City of Science and Technology logo at bottom right, including the teal mountain icon and the text 'جامعة زويل للعلوم والتكنولوجيا' and 'University of Science and Technology'.
9. Add a circle badge at top right containing the number '1', with white fill, purple outline (#7b1fa2), and black number.
10. Add a black horizontal strip along the very bottom edge.
11. Optionally place a white arrow mouse cursor on the right side.
12. Verify all text matches verbatim and alignment matches the original.
